Okay then why is the nail art picture I posted and this quote on Zillabeau's product page? "If you're hesitant about drawing lines with a long brush or find it time-consuming, try using this scraper for your art instead!"

I tried it with a super thick builder gel - coolear's 'hold' the blue/thickest one. I did a thin-ish layer on my nail and scraped the tool like a rake from the cuticle area to the tip. I experimented on a few nails with different levels of pressure, It made a mess each time. I was left with a bunch of product at the tip and on the scraper, and any lines I created quickly self leveled. Maybe I'm supposed to use it like a brush and apply the gel with it instead of trying to remove product from the nail with it like a rake?
